statement: A rank-one bilinear crossing with arbitrary same-bank quadratic curvature does not admit a universal critical half-Riesz bound. For independent cap-one Y,Z uniform on [-1/2,1/2], -Y^2-Z^2+2YZ=-(Y-Z)^2 and E|R|^{-1/2}=infinity. This is not a QFORM counterexample because the two-variable coefficient matrix has only one nonzero eigenvalue.
replacement: QFORM-RANK1-SAMEBANK-SQRT-SMALLBALL-v1 and QFORM-RANK1-SAMEBANK-SUBCRITICAL-RIESZ-v1: square-root small-ball is uniform and H_beta is uniformly bounded for every beta<1/2.
